shipped_rows.title_o: Reducing the Racial Achievement Gap: A Social-Psychological Intervention

blind_target.evidence_quote: Though low-cost value affirmation interventions have been shown to reduce achievement gaps in some classroom settings, these findings have not been consistently replicated. In this study, we test the efficacy of this intervention among a new sample of students enrolled in a community college in the Midwest.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Overall, we find little evidence of a positive effect of this one-time affirmation of social identity.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict indicates little evidence for the intervention effect. Abstract does not identify the original paper; no citation guessed.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract describes value-affirmation findings from some classroom settings and says the intervention is tested in a new community-college sample, but it does not identify the original report or reports whose specific findings are retested. The supplied Cohen et al. (2006) row is plausible but cannot be tied to the described finding from the available source text. Need the article’s cited prior finding(s) or a relevant Results/Discussion passage naming the original comparison(s), plus enough reference identity to determine whether row 302 represents one of them.

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
